item_summary: $60-90 smart LED desk lamp with ambient light sensors for auto-dimming, adjustable color temperature, and an integrated wireless charging base
detailed_item_draft: Seeking a smart LED desk lamp priced between $60 and $90 USD. Must feature an integrated ambient light sensor capable of real-time auto-dimming adjustments to maintain consistent illumination levels. Color temperature must be adjustable from 2700K warm white to 6500K cool daylight. The base must include a Qi-compatible wireless charging pad with at least 10W output for fast charging smartphones. Lighting source should be flicker-free with high CRI (greater than 90) to reduce eye strain during extended work sessions. Control methods should include touch-sensitive panels and ideally mobile app connectivity for scheduling and brightness presets. Voice assistant compatibility (Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant) is preferred. Build quality requires a stable, weighted base with a compact footprint suitable for modern workspaces. Materials should be durable with a matte finish to minimize glare. Power supply should be included with efficient cable management.
